decision: No call/frame prototype justified by this bounded source pass. Existing calls bind directly into final slots. Consumed-operand reuse requires overlapping binding/default/error/return ownership handling while R411 already loses with tail borrowing. Managed compilation could remove dispatch,but one-shot cost,complete native coverage and safe exact continuation remain unmeasured. Keep qualified native engine; do not infer removable shares or add a parallel backend. Independent changed producer assets qualify next.
